diorama.settings.title: Map settings
diorama.settings.render_style.tooltip: Plain draws the terrain as it is lit. Outlined darkens every edge. Painted turns the map into a hand-painted fantasy map: light in flat cel-shaded bands, soft ink lines, inked coasts with foam and ripples, brushwork and paper grain. Painted, no outlines keeps the paint and drops the ink lines.
diorama.settings.clouds.tooltip: Pixel-art clouds drift over explored ground and cast their shadows on it. Only a picture over the map: it never redraws it.
diorama.settings.coast.tooltip: Foam breathes along the water's edge, ripples roll in on calm water, and waves break on the open sea's shores. Only drawn over the map: it never redraws it. Coasts saved before this show it once they are drawn again.
diorama.settings.seed_preview.tooltip: Sketch approximate biomes in the singleplayer Overworld (26.3). When unavailable, unknown areas keep blank parchment.
diorama.settings.antique_tint.tooltip: With either antique map, also tint the explored terrain toward the old paper, a little desaturated and warmed. Off keeps the explored map in its own colours; only the unknown is drawn as an old map.
diorama.settings.fog_style.tooltip: Antique map draws unexplored land as pixel-art sepia cartography; the color variant tints the biomes. Clouds draws pixel-art clouds.
diorama.banner.title: Banner
diorama.banner.from_held.tooltip: Copies the banner in your hand, or the first one in your inventory
diorama.settings.extra_banner_layers.too: Lifts the loom's limit of 6 layers. Such banners still show on the maps, but can't be made as a vanilla banner item.
diorama.book.look.render_hint: Redrawing the map can take a few seconds.
diorama.book.layers.hint: On the map, C switches between the surface and the caves, and Page Up and Page Down move the slice.
diorama.book.radar.hint: The radar marks players and creatures near you on the minimap and on this map, within the height range above and below you.
diorama.book.banners.empty: No banners in this dimension yet. Right-click the map to plant one, or use New to plant one where you stand.
diorama.book.banners.pick: Pick a banner on the left page, or right-click the map to plant a new one.
diorama.book.help:
Drag to pan, scroll to zoom
Right-click: plant a banner, copy coordinates, teleport
C caves · Page Up/Down slice · Space recenter
The ribbons on the right open the book
diorama.reveal.pick: Click the opposite corner · %s × %s chunks · right-click or Esc cancels
diorama.reveal.started: Revealing… land never visited is generated
diorama.reveal.denied: Revealing needs creative or cheats, in singleplayer
diorama.regions.read_only: regions.json is from a newer version: its regions can't be changed here
diorama.regions.surface_only: Regions are drawn on the surface map
diorama.regions.hint.lasso: Lasso: drag around a region · right button drags the map · Esc leaves
diorama.regions.hint.polygon: Polygon: click the corners, then the first one or Enter · Backspace takes one back · Esc leaves
diorama.regions.hint.eraser: Eraser: click a region to erase it · Ctrl+Z brings it back · Esc leaves
diorama.regions.tool.lasso.tip: Lasso (%s): drag around a region; letting go closes it
diorama.regions.tool.polygon.tip: Polygon (%s): click each corner; click the first one, double-click or press Enter to close
diorama.regions.tool.eraser.tip: Eraser (%s): click a region to erase it
diorama.regions.fill.tip: Fill of the next region: none, light, normal or strong. Click to change
diorama.book.regions.empty: No regions here yet. Draw one with the button below, or right-click the map.
diorama.book.regions.pick: Pick a region on the left, or click one on the map.
diorama.book.regions.tools_hint: Right-click the map and pick Draw a region, or bind a key to Draw regions. Lasso (1), polygon (2), edit (3) and eraser (4); Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y undo and redo. While drawing, the right or middle button drags the map.
diorama.regions.tool.edit.tip: Edit (%s): click a region, then drag its corners; click a side to add a corner, right-click one to take it away, drag inside to move the region
diorama.regions.hint.edit_pick: Edit: click a region to change its shape · Esc leaves
diorama.regions.hint.edit: Editing %s: drag corners · click a side to add one · right-click removes · drag inside moves
diorama.book.regions.label: Name on the map
diorama.settings.region_style.tooltip: How regions are drawn. Automatic follows the map's render style (or the antique map). A region can have a style of its own in the book.
diorama.settings.region_band.tooltip: A band of each region's dye along the inside of its border, strongest at the border and fading inwards, as strategy games draw territories. While it is on, the inside has no other colour.
